verdict.rationale: Obsidian documents a community plugin system for integrating third-party services, and community testimony confirms an AI plugin ecosystem exists. The Text-Generator plugin is cited as a long-standing productive LLM interface that pulls links and backlinks into context, though the same user says no AI plugin offers decent RAG. The pack shows no first-party AI or LLM connector, so delivery rests on a thinly evidenced third-party ecosystem. missing for 10: first-party LLM/AI connectors, documented catalog or depth of AI plugins, working RAG over the vault, independent corroboration beyond a single community comment.
